scenarios.title: Delve pays generic mana by exiling cards from the graveyard
decisions: A casts Gurmag Angler ({6}{B}), exiling all five cards from A's graveyard for delve and tapping Swamp and Swamp.

variants.label: five_cards
variants.expected: The cast is legal: five exiled cards pay five generic mana, one Swamp pays the generic mana and the other pays {B}. Gurmag Angler is on the stack and A's graveyard is empty.

variants.label: four_cards
variants.expected: The cast is not legal: four exiled cards and two lands cover only six of the seven mana.

variants.label: no_black_source
variants.delta: A's two lands are Mountains instead of Swamps.
variants.expected: The cast is not legal: delve cannot pay the colored {B}.

scenarios.title: Delve applies after the total cost is determined
decisions: A casts Treasure Cruise ({7}{U}), exiling all five cards from A's graveyard for delve and tapping Island and Island.

variants.label: cost_reduced
variants.expected: The cast is legal: Goblin Electromancer first reduces the total cost to {6}{U}, then five exiled cards and one Island pay the generic mana and the other Island pays {U}.

variants.label: no_reduction
variants.delta: Goblin Electromancer is not on the battlefield.
variants.expected: The cast is not legal: the total cost stays {7}{U} and five exiled cards plus two Islands cover only seven of the eight mana.
